behaviorAndRecovery: Actual baseline public CLI ignored invalid explicit PEER_EXTRA_CA_CERTS and proceeded to model/tool execution. New adapter rejects prior to dispatch, preserves original file/config/history and permits the same ready task after repair.

One native Network Module owns captured proxy/extra-CA environment, exact original protocol/env/NO_PROXY precedence, bounded trust material and fresh per-physical-request route. Model generation and frozen count share it. Pinned ChatGPT/Google exchanges and refresh share the same Module without token/code replay.

Physical HTTP forward proxy receives absolute original URL and proxy Basic authentication; NO_PROXY connects directly even when configured proxy is unavailable. HTTPS CONNECT proxy carries authentication only to proxy, while upstream TLS/model headers exclude it. The adapter does not project route/auth values into output, Context/history, Evidence or request trace; actual fixture outputs contain none.

Actual Rustls TLS rejects untrusted root and wrong hostname; explicit PEER_EXTRA_CA_CERTS and legacy NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS augment rather than replace built-in roots. A new task after adding explicit trust executes a real file tool with Grant/ToolResult/Evidence. No accept-invalid setting exists.

Count + two generation requests traverse the actual forward proxy, retain original prepared count/send payloads, usage 46 and actual tool Evidence. One model OAuth refresh plus two generation requests similarly traverse the proxy; exactly one token POST occurs. Invalid proxy rejected before send restores only the owned never-sent refresh reservation by original CAS; actual stored token stays equal and a subsequent task succeeds.

Explicit CA file limits reject >1MiB, invalid UTF8, directories and FIFO without blocking, changing config, dispatching a model or executing a tool. Errors contain static codes, not the configured URL/credential.

macOS reads fixed scutil HTTP(S) settings per request and imports only TS-equivalent user/admin non-denied public certificate fingerprints. OS reads have bounded output, two-second query deadline and owned termination/wait. Actual cancellation/timeout/output exhaustion reap the owned query process and permit the next query. Non-macOS skips these system queries; explicit env remains authoritative.

No new model-visible capability, permission, execution fact or Evidence path. Existing unknown/pending and no-replay tests rerun. Ordinary synthetic Host tests explicitly bypass personal proxies, and network tests individually select real local fixture routes.
